evidenceDAG.labels: Conceptual evidence roles only, not allocated formal IDs or assigned output paths.
evidenceDAG.static: S = immutable approved original source map/data and current Task/user-authority/WHY/fences. Only source that exists at build time is pinned into S. S need not contain future native-install receipt, receiver-use evidence, final packet or method receipt.
sequence: After separately authorized finite session/bootstrap/install preparation, deliver S and actual current producer result/receipt references through existing owned source/native tools. Any later install receipt or current source evidence not in S is delivered/read through its exact owner-selected existing source-reference transport; never alter S/hash or invent a future map entry.

Receiver genuinely reads/applies complete whole WHY/current own Task/user scope/fences and all five actual producer prerequisite results, including actual install result. Observe the real native event through a supported native-owner path. General/dependent effects remain held.

Write immutable E = actual allowlisted native event observation, and U0 = genuine receiving/use of those exact producer results for THIS receiving Task. U0 records source IDs/raw hashes, receiving Task/instruction/source revision, actual application and unknowns. U0/E contain no future packet/receipt/document hash and do not claim packet-read before packet exists.

Compute hash(U0), then construct CURRENT packet Q with real native IDs, current context/source selections and five prerequisites whose receiverReceipt refs name U0 (or separate actual per-producer records). Native install producer receipt must already be actual. Derive q=workMethodPacketSha256(Q). No template restricts future receiverReceipt refs.

Receiver reads/applies the COMPLETE final Q and standing, including newly materialized receiving refs/current context; before the specifically dependent action, write U1 recording q and genuine current application. U1 can reference E/U0/S and q; Q MUST NOT reference U1.

Construct common receipt R binding q/task hash/current actor/route/protocol/adapter; useEvidence/admission evidence reference U1 and other actual source evidence. R does not reference its own file/container hash. Any recovery route authorityReloaded/transitionRefs remain genuine. consumedBeforeEffects names the actual still-pending dependent boundary and time, never retroactively authorizes prior create/install/first-read.

Freshly observe all required sources for Q/standing/R plus current event and prerequisite assertions. Build O = owner admission input and call SAME existing full-event owner reader; derive decision A and complete document D afterwards. Final request/result/document may contain Q/R/O hashes, but no ancestor includes D's own hash.

Paginated D carries full-document hash; continuation must match it. Source output/page success does not supply receive/use/admission/permission. Lost/stale/changed source or event/packet causes existing holds. No replayed receiver-use evidence for another Task/instruction/source/native event.
evidenceDAG.hashOrder: S + producer evidence + E -> U0 -> Q/q -> U1 -> R -> O/A -> D. References point to earlier immutable bytes; Q does not contain U1/R/D hashes, U0/E do not contain q. No selfhash/fixed-point calculation.
evidenceDAG.bootstrapBoundary: Raw delivery/reading occurs only as explicitly authorized bounded bootstrap; it grants no general execution. Method receipt qualifies its named later dependent effects only. If current Task requires admission before a bootstrap effect already taken, that cannot be repaired retroactively: preserve actual effect and choose the proper existing owner admission/Task boundary.
evidenceDAG.currentPacketRead: U0 is prerequisite consumption; U1 is actual final packet receive/use. Keeping them separate avoids claiming receipt.used for a packet that was never read. Existing Common checks require both qualified prerequisite receiverUsed and receipt.received/used.
evidenceDAG.dynamicTransport: New source reader's owner-document input already carries all current structures via bounded stdin; it performs no arbitrary receipt-file IO. Actual independent source reads/receipt writing stay with existing native/source owners and exact Task result paths, not a new runtime store.
